name: Notice of Non-Residency Hearing
description: When a family timely requests a hearing, notice of the hearing (with the Procedural Safeguards Notice—Charge of Non-Residency) is sent by certified, first class and electronic mail at least three days in advance.
deadline: at least three (3) days advance notice of the hearing
quote: If the student’s parent/guardian timely requests a hearing to challenge the administration’s determination, a hearing shall be scheduled, notification of which shall be sent to the parent/guardian by certified mail, first class mail, and electronic mail (if available).
